Myth vs fact: Myth: a Lighthouse 100 means accessible.

05-myth-https.linkedin:
Myth vs fact: Myth: the padlock means the site is secure.

HTTPS encrypts the trip between the browser and the server. It says nothing about the page's scripts, headers and cookies, or about who is behind the site.

Check it: Check what the padlock does not cover: response headers, cookie flags, outdated scripts and a DMARC record.

07-pre-release.title: The 10-minute pre-release check.
07-pre-release.alt: Checklist card. The 10-minute pre-release check. Checks: Meta robots, robots.txt, Canonical, Status codes, Mixed content, Console, A real form, Analytics, Cache, Sitemap.
steps: Check that no page still carries a noindex left over from staging.
Open robots.txt and make sure no Disallow: / was left over.
Check that canonical tags point to production, not staging.
Request a real page and a made-up one: 200 and 404.
Look for http:// images, scripts or styles on https pages.
Open the console and look for new errors.
Send one real form and wait for the success message.
Check that analytics reports to the production property.
Hard-reload and confirm the new CSS and JavaScript are served.
Open the sitemap and find the new pages in it.

14-a11y-check.title: The 5-minute accessibility check.
14-a11y-check.alt: Checklist card. The 5-minute accessibility check. Checks: Zoom to 200%, Narrow to 320 px, Page title, Link text, Language.
steps: Zoom the browser to 200% and check that nothing is cut off (WCAG 1.4.4).
Narrow the window to 320 CSS pixels and check there is no sideways scrolling (WCAG 1.4.10).
Read the tab title: it should say what the page is (WCAG 2.4.2).
Read each link: its text, with its context, should say where it goes (WCAG 2.4.4).
View source and check that the html element has a lang attribute (WCAG 3.1.1).
14-a11y-check.linkedin:
Checklist: The 5-minute accessibility check.

Google a déclaré en 2009 qu'il n'utilise pas la balise meta keywords pour le classement web. La balise montre en revanche à vos concurrents les mots que vous visez.

Vérifiez : Cherchez name="keywords" dans vos modèles. Supprimez-la et rédigez plutôt une vraie description pour chaque page clé.

it.title: Mito: le meta keywords aiutano ancora il posizionamento.
